analysis_rules.correctness: All Stage2 tolerances unchanged, all history rows plus covered field checkpoints tested
analysis_rules.divergence: FAIL if any frozen tolerance fails. GROWING if a checkpoint error at >=5000 exceeds both4x its step1000 value and1% of its frozen tolerance. Otherwise STABLE within the tested contract; this does not claim exact equality or machine-epsilon noise.
analysis_rules.performance_stability: Compare median steady GPU rates at5000 and10000: relative change<=5% STABLE; fall>5% DEGRADING; rise>5% IMPROVING_AFTER_WARMUP.
analysis_rules.severe_performance_stop: At5000: median GPU rate<80% of1000 median, or last1000-step window rate<80% of first full1000-step interval after warmup.
analysis_rules.memory_growth_stop: After initialization, VRAM growth>256MiB or solver RSS growth>512MiB between steady thirds, with nondecreasing thirds; report measurements before10000.
analysis_rules.migration_stop: If post-optimization short profile ordinary-step managed bytes exceed Stage2 ordinary-step bytes by>20%, stop10000 cases. Late5000 migration count is UNVERIFIED without trace.
analysis_rules.fit: Ordinary least squares T=A+b*N on all valid unprofiled repetitions; S_fit=1/b. Report residuals and measured horizon brackets.
analysis_rules.projections: Only if5000/10000 GPU rates stable within5%, all correctness PASS and no divergence; use current10000 median sustained speeds, fitted fixed overhead, mark PROJECTED.

storage: All required files written during E2E. After successful close/checksum, byte-identical Stage3 snapshots may be hardlinked without deleting any path or changing bytes.
